name: 玛蒂尔德
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_一_犁的年月.md:189
who: Mathilde, a human midwife of the Grey Rain city, once a bowwoman, thirty-nine and looking it: about 166 cm, medium height with the even shoulders and strong forearms of someone who has drawn a bow for years. Short copper-red hair cut to the roots of her ears, plastered to her forehead in the rain, and after the frost month a single lock of white at her left temple (on the viewer's right when they face us). Emerald-green eyes that look at a person's hands first. The pads of three fingers on her right hand are thickened with calluses, and a worn old bowstring is wound round her left wrist and never taken off. A level, quick, sparing-with-words air, soft-hearted in the hands.
build: 166 cm, even-shouldered and strong-armed: a long, sturdy back, a C-cup, a narrow waist and gently rounded hips.
palette: copper red and emerald green, faded oilcloth grey-brown, undyed wool, one white lock
casual: Her midwife's clothes: a faded oilcloth cloak over a long coarse-wool skirt with the sleeves rolled to the elbow, a stout leather medicine pouch at her belt holding scissors, clean cloths, a small bottle of spirits and a few herbs, sturdy walking shoes; the old bowstring wound three times round her left wrist. She stands with one hand on the pouch, a calm, practical look.
private: Home by the lamp after a long night: a plain undyed wool dress with the sleeves rolled to the elbows, a knitted shawl, soft house shoes, the cloak hung on a peg. She holds a mug of hot herb tea in both hands, the bowstring still on her wrist. A tired, quiet, kind look.
battle: Going out on a night that might turn bad: the oilcloth cloak fastened at the throat, the skirt kilted up over leggings and boots, leather bracers over the rolled sleeves, the medicine pouch tied shut. She holds a plain old hunting bow low in her left hand with one arrow loose between the fingers of her right, the string she once drew every day; a steady, level look.
formal: At a naming day in the city: her one good dress of dark-blue wool in an old loose cut, long sleeves and a plain white collar folded flat and open at the neck, a wide cord belt, the oilcloth cloak left at home. A small bead cut with a faint wall-rune hangs on a thread and glows softly when a child is born near. The bowstring is still on her wrist. She stands with the hands folded, a warm, composed look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the green eyes looking straight at the viewer and then down at your hands, a small closed-mouth smile. Cold grey rain light from one side and a warm lantern glow from below. Foreground blur: rain drops and a loop of old bowstring across her wrist. She wears the faded oilcloth cloak.

name: 迪特里希
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_一_犁的年月.md:245
who: Dietrich, a human cooper of the Grey Rain city, forty-three: about 182 cm, tall and spare with broad shoulders and long, strong arms whose backs are covered in old burns and splinter scars. Black hair cropped very short with the temples already white, deep-blue eyes with two dark shadows under them from nights without sleep, a long old knife scar along the left ribs under his shirt. A quiet, alert, hands-before-words air; he sits with a straight back and turns his head at every small sound.
build: Tall, spare and wiry, broad in the shoulder, with long, tough forearms.
palette: slate blue and charcoal, cask-oak brown, scorched canvas, dull brass
casual: His cooper's clothes: a thick canvas apron with a scraper, wooden wedges and a small hammer in the pocket, over a patched linen shirt with the sleeves rolled up and dark trousers, an old sheepskin coat on his shoulders for the cold, a string of brass door-latch clasps he made himself hanging at his belt. He holds a half-finished barrel stave, a watchful, steady look.
private: Evening at the table: a loose undyed linen shirt with the collar open and the sleeves rolled, the apron hung on its nail, soft old shoes. He is smoothing a small wooden toy with a thumb, the burn-scarred hands at rest. A tired, gentle look.
battle: On the night the inspectors came: the canvas apron off, a dark leather jerkin buckled over the shirt, boots, the string of brass clasps still at his belt, a plain long knife held low behind his leg in his right hand, a heavy cooper's mallet hanging at his left hip; he stands in a doorway with the weight on the back foot, a hard, level stare.
formal: At a neighbour's wedding: a clean dark wool coat of an old loose cut worn open over a grey linen shirt with the collar folded down, the string of brass door-latch clasps at his belt, a small hardwood wedge cut with a rune that warms in the hand tucked in the pocket, brushed boots, the apron left at home. He stands very straight with the hands folded, a quiet, awkward look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the head turned a little as if hearing something, the deep-blue eyes looking at the viewer steadily over shadowed eye-bags. Warm lamp glow from one side, cold blue night light from the other. Foreground blur: oak shavings and a hanging brass latch clasp. He wears the canvas apron over the linen shirt.

name: 瑟尔卡
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_一_犁的年月.md:301
who: Selka, a human gatekeeper of the Grey Rain city, fifty-one: about 174 cm, tall, heavy-boned and broad, with forearms thicker than most men's. Grey-white short hair tied back at the nape with a leather cord, a square face reddened by years of the fire in the gate passage, an old scar across the right brow (on the viewer's left when they face us), pale grey eyes that look at what a person is holding before they look at the person. Her jaw is firm and her gaze is level and slow. A blunt, steady, careful-underneath air; she carries two full buckets as if they were empty.
build: 174 cm, tall and heavy-set: very broad shoulders, thick strong arms, a D-cup, a thick waist and sturdy rounded hips.
face: FACE, as in the references: a square, weathered face of a woman past fifty, a firm jaw, a broad forehead, fine lines at the eyes and mouth; pale grey, level, slightly narrowed eyes; strong straight brows with a short old scar cutting through the right one; a wide mouth with a firm closed line; reddened cheeks from the fire. Skin shadows are a soft warm brown-pink.
palette: gate-fire red and soot grey, polished old leather brown, oilcloth green-grey, iron
casual: Her gatekeeper's clothes: an old wall-guard's leather armour with the breast plate rubbed bright from years of wear, over a thick wool shirt with the sleeves rolled, a heavy oilcloth cloak, a small knife at her belt for cutting day-marks into the gate post, sturdy boots. She stands square in the gate passage with her arms folded, a patient, level look.
private: Beside the gate fire at night: a plain long-sleeved wool tunic and trousers, the armour hung on its peg, thick socks and old shoes. She holds a wooden cup of water, and a dipper hangs beside her; a short spear and a round shield lean unmoved against the wall behind her. A quiet, watchful look.
battle: Holding the gate: the old leather armour buckled tight, the oilcloth cloak thrown back, leather bracers over the rolled sleeves. She grips a short spear low in her right hand and a plain round shield in her left, the feet planted wide in the middle of the passage so that it looks half as wide; a flat, unmoving stare.
formal: On the morning of an inspection at the gate: the same old wall-guard's leather armour freshly oiled, the breast plate rubbed bright with a worn wall-rune on it that still holds a faint light, a plain undyed grey tabard with no trim at all, the brown oilcloth cloak brushed clean, the hair tied back tight. She stands very straight in the middle of the passage with the spear grounded beside her, a serious, steady look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the pale grey eyes looking at the viewer and then down at your hands, a firm closed mouth. Warm orange light from a gate fire on one side, cold rain light on the other. Foreground blur: sparks from the fire and a wooden dipper handle. She wears the old leather armour and the oilcloth cloak.

name: 西蒙
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_一_犁的年月.md:357
who: Simon, a human stone-carver of the Grey Rain city who cuts names into the wall, sixty-one: about 175 cm, of middle height with a slight stoop from forty years bent over lettering and one shoulder higher than the other from swinging the mallet in his right hand. Greying white hair wrapped in a strip of cloth, narrowed, squinting eyes with deep crow's feet that go dim after dusk, big rough hands with stone dust packed under the nails. He clears his throat before he speaks. A slow, fine-working, stubborn air.
build: Stocky and sturdy, a slight stoop, the right shoulder a little higher than the left.
face: FACE, as in the references: an old man's lined face, deep crow's feet and creases round the squinting grey eyes, bushy greying brows, a heavy nose, thin pale lips, a lined forehead mostly hidden by the cloth wrap, white stubble on the cheeks. Skin shadows are a soft warm brown.
palette: stone-dust white, worn grey linen, leather brown, a little chisel steel
casual: His carver's clothes: a coarse smock whitened with stone dust, the leather apron hanging on the door until the frost month and tied on again after, a leather pouch at the belt with a dozen chisels and a wooden mallet, a strip of cloth round his hair, thick old shoes. He holds a half-cut stone slab with a row of fresh letters, a squinting, patient look.
private: Resting in his stone house: an old undyed wool shirt with the sleeves rolled, a knitted waistcoat, soft felt slippers. He sits with his rough hands wrapped round a mug of warm broth, the stone dust still in his nails. A tired, mild look.
battle: A man who does not fight; the stone-carver at work on the wall at dusk: the dust-whitened smock, the leather apron tied on, a lantern hung close on a hook beside him. He is cutting a name with a narrow chisel held in his left hand and the wooden mallet raised in his right, leaning in close to the stone; a squinting, absorbed stare.
battle_pose: 3) the working outfit: braced close against the wall, the shoulders hunched in, the feet planted, a squinting, absorbed look, cutting a name into the stone with a chisel in one hand and a mallet raised in the other; he does not fight.
formal: At a naming ceremony at the wall: a clean dark wool coat of a roomy old cut worn open at the neck over a pale linen shirt, the cloth strip replaced with a neat brown felt cap, the chisel pouch at his belt with one chisel whose cut edge faintly glimmers in the dusk. He stands with the hands folded in front, a grave, mild look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the head tilted, the squinting grey eyes looking at the viewer as if reading a stone, a small dry cough-ready look. Warm lamp glow from one side catching the dust on his shoulders. Foreground blur: drifting stone dust and the edge of a freshly cut letter. He wears the dust-whitened smock.

name: 柯恩
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_一_犁的年月.md:413
who: Koen, a fourteen-year-old human errand boy of the Grey Rain city's craftsmen's street, soon to be a stone-carver's apprentice: about 158 cm, thin and growing fast, wholly covered by his clothes. Untidy flax-coloured hair that he cuts himself with sheep shears, one tuft over the forehead that always sticks up, a streak of soot on his face and hands that never washes out. Orange-gold eyes like sparks, squinting from long hours beside the forge. An old burn scar on the web of his right thumb (on the viewer's left when they face us). A quick, scruffy, willing air.
palette: flax and soot grey, ember orange, patched brown wool, a little leather brown
casual: His errand-boy clothes: a smith's leather apron cut down but still reaching his knees, over a patched coarse shirt and trousers that stop short of his boots, a sheepskin coat from the bone-smith over it in the cold; a small steel file at his belt and, since the frost month, a leather pouch holding three chisels. He holds the pouch strap with one hand, an eager, squinting look.
private: Evening in the stone-carver's workshop: an oversized undyed wool shirt with the sleeves rolled, patched trousers, thick socks and old shoes, the apron hung up. He warms his hands round a cup of hot milk, a sleepy, content look.
battle: Running a night errand through the streets: the sheepskin coat buttoned to the collar, the apron tied close, the pouch of chisels slung across his chest, boots laced tight. He holds a small shuttered lantern out in front of him in both hands to light the way; he carries no weapon.
battle_pose: 3) the night-errand outfit: braced and alert, the feet planted, a firm expression, holding a shuttered lantern out in front of him in both hands to light the road; he does not fight.
formal: On the day he is taken on as an apprentice: his one clean shirt with the collar left open under a patched but brushed brown wool jacket with big mismatched buttons, the trousers let down at the hem, the new leather pouch of three chisels at his belt, one chisel scratched with a tiny rune that gleams faintly, hair wetted down at last. He stands very straight with the hands at his sides, a solemn, hopeful look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the orange-gold eyes squinting at the viewer with a bright, eager, serious look, a smear of soot on one cheek. Warm orange forge light from one side and cool grey street light from the other. Foreground blur: drifting sparks and a chisel handle. He wears the cut-down leather apron over the patched shirt.

name: 琳恩
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_一_犁的年月.md:620
who: Lynn, a human novice of the White Candle shrine in a southern wall-city, sixteen years old and looks it: small, about 155 cm, wholly covered by her clothes. A round face, short sakura-pink hair tucked behind her ears, a dusting of flour on her eyebrows, honey-coloured eyes that look first to see whether a person is carrying anything. The backs of her hands are reddened from the oven, her nails cut very short. A cheerful, plain-spoken, bread-smelling air; she cannot sit still without something in her hands.
palette: sakura pink and honey amber, novice grey, flour white, warm crust brown
casual: Her novice's clothes: a plain grey novice's robe with the sleeves rolled to the elbow, closed at the neck with buttons, a flour-dusted apron tied over it, sturdy shoes; a basket covered with a cloth hooked on one arm, with a small flask hidden underneath the loaves. She stands with the basket held in front of her, an open, bright look.
private: Early morning in the shrine kitchen: a long-sleeved, high-necked undyed wool house dress under a knitted shawl, warm socks and soft shoes, the pink hair loose. She sits on a stool holding a warm bun in both hands, an earnest, sleepy look.
battle: Not a fighter; on the night watch beside a sickbed: the grey robe buttoned to the collar, the flour apron tied on, a white candle lit and held upright in both hands in front of her. She keeps her feet together and her chin up, an earnest, steady look; she carries no weapon.
battle_pose: 3) the night-watch outfit: steady and earnest, the feet together, the chin up, holding a lit white candle upright in both hands in front of her; she does not fight.
formal: At the shrine's morning service: a clean white novice's robe with narrow grey trim and a soft turned-down collar, long plain sleeves, a rope belt, hair neatly pinned back behind the ears. She holds a white candle in both hands whose small flame never gutters and gives off no smoke. She stands very straight, a solemn, careful look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the honey eyes open and looking straight at the viewer with an earnest, serious look, the mouth closed. Warm golden light from a bakery oven on one side, cool dawn light on the other. Foreground blur: drifting flour and a crusty loaf in a cloth-covered basket. She wears the grey robe with the flour-dusted apron.

name: 卡斯滕
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_一_犁的年月.md:676
who: Karsten, a human scout of a southern wall-city, nineteen: about 181 cm, tall and lean with long legs and a runner's wiry frame. Messily cropped sand-gold hair, a red sunburn line across the bridge of his nose, pale blue-green eyes narrowed from squinting into the distance, the brow furrowing first whenever he looks far. On his left wrist (on the viewer's right when they face us) a blackened old brass bell on a cord, engraved with a small spell-squad pattern; it rings with every step. A dry, quick, talkative air.
build: Lean and long-legged, wiry rather than bulky.
palette: sand gold and dust khaki, pale blue-green, blackened brass, white cloth strip
casual: His scout's clothes: a short sand-coloured scout's cloak with a strip of white cloth sewn round the edge of the hood so he can be found again after a patrol, over a plain tunic and trousers tucked into dusty boots; at his belt a coil of long rope, a string of small bells, a water flask and a short knife. The old brass bell hangs at his left wrist. A squinting, easy look.
private: Off duty in the barracks: a loose undyed linen shirt, the sleeves rolled, soft trousers and bare ankles in old shoes, the cloak thrown over a chair. He sits sideways, half asleep, the brass bell still on his wrist. A drowsy, relaxed look.
battle: Scouting the line: the short sand-coloured cloak pulled forward with the white-edged hood up, leather bracers, the rope coiled across his chest with small rune knots, the muffled bells in his belt, the short knife drawn and held low in his right hand, the left hand spread flat as if feeling the air; a crouching, listening, narrow-eyed stance.
formal: At the wall-city's morning muster: a clean sand-coloured tabard over a dark tunic with the collar open, the white-edged hood folded back on his shoulders, brushed boots, a small brass bell on his belt silenced with a thread, a thin white cloth strip tied round one arm. A faint trail of pale rune-dust marks the tabard hem. He stands at attention, a stiff, slightly amused look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned toward the distance and then to the viewer, the pale blue-green eyes squinting, the brow furrowing, a crooked half-grin. Hard golden desert light from one side. Foreground blur: drifting sand grains and a loop of rope. He wears the sand-coloured cloak with the white-edged hood.

name: 阿尔诺
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_一_犁的年月.md:840
who: Arno, a human winding-hand of the clockwork-soldier winding yard at the southern end of the wall, seventy: about 181 cm, tall and thin with a back bent a little forward, walking with both hands clasped behind him as if driving something. A face as creased as old leather, white stubble, deep-set eyes of a washed-out pale blue that count how many people are behind you before they look at you. Both hands are stained with oil in the lines of the skin, and the left little finger is missing its upper half (on the viewer's right when they face us), taken by a machine's knee joint when he was young. A dry, patient, counting air. The left little finger is clearly missing its upper half, a stump with a healed rounded end, drawn on the hand on the viewer's right when they face us, and kept visible in the hanging or lowered hand in every outfit panel.
build: Tall, thin and stooped, with long dry arms.
face: FACE, as in the references: an old man's long, deeply creased face like worn leather; white stubble; deep-set faded pale-blue eyes with heavy lids and crow's feet; thick white brows; a long nose; thin lips pressed in a flat line. Skin shadows are a soft warm brown.
palette: oil-stained canvas brown, pale faded blue, brass, tired white
casual: His winding-hand's clothes: an oil-soaked old canvas jacket buttoned to the throat, a brass-cornered ledger worn soft at the edges in the pocket, a tiny brass whistle on a leather cord at his neck, a long hooked pole at his belt for turning keys and hooking steam-bags, and a small crank handle in the pocket; dark trousers and heavy boots. He stands with his hands behind his back, a patient, counting look.
private: Night in the yard: a long-sleeved undyed wool shirt under a knitted waistcoat, a thick shawl, old slippers. He sits on a bench with a mug of warm water, the ledger open on his knee. A quiet, tired look.
battle: Not a fighter; winding the line of kneeling machines at dawn: the oil-soaked canvas jacket, the whistle at his neck, a long hooked pole in his right hand and a small crank handle in his left, bent to turn a key set in a kneeling machine's back; a focused, careful look.
battle_pose: 3) the winding outfit: bent forward and absorbed, the feet apart and planted, a long hooked pole in one hand and a small crank handle in the other, turning a key in the back of a kneeling clockwork soldier; he does not fight.
formal: At the yard's roll-call: the old canvas jacket brushed clean and worn open at the neck over a clean grey shirt, the brass whistle polished on its cord, a small brass winding key on a chain at his belt that ticks softly by itself, the ledger held against his chest, hair combed flat. He stands very straight with the free hand at his side, a grave, dry look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the head tilted, the faded blue eyes looking past the viewer to count the people behind, then back, a dry, patient look. Warm brass-coloured light from one side and cool pale dawn from the other. Foreground blur: a small brass whistle swinging on its cord and a drifting thread of steam. He wears the oil-soaked canvas jacket.

name: 托娃
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_一_犁的年月.md:896
who: Tova, a dwarf furnace-smith of the Deepwell clan, one hundred and ten and looking about thirty-five: about 138 cm, short, thick and sturdy with broad shoulders and a back built for the furnace. A face reddened by furnace fire, eyebrows that burned off once and grew back short, honey-gold hair braided in three plaits tied up at the back of her head with a brass ring (a Deepwell woman's plaits and rings say whose house she belongs to). Black eyes with big pupils that squint in bright light and only open wide in the dark. Hard-skinned hands with thick fingers that nevertheless touch things very lightly. A blunt, steady, listening-to-the-iron air.
build: 138 cm, short, thick and sturdy: broad shoulders and back, a D-cup, a strong waist and full rounded hips; she swings a great hammer all day and carries a slab of mountain-copper in her arms.
palette: furnace red and soot black, honey gold, dull mountain-copper, thick leather brown
casual: Her furnace-smith's clothes: a thick Deepwell leather apron with a row of chisels along the chest (the finest she calls the needle), over a heavy wool shirt with the sleeves rolled to the elbows, dark trousers and iron-capped boots; a small leather pouch of furnace ash at her waist that she rubs between her palms before touching anything. She carries no lamp. She holds a chisel in one hand, a squinting, appraising look.
private: At the end of a shift: a loose undyed linen shirt with the sleeves rolled, the apron hung up, patched wool trousers and soft cloth shoes, the three plaits undone into one loose braid. She holds a big tankard in both hands, a tired, content look.
battle: At the furnace mouth: the leather apron tied tight, thick forearm guards, iron-capped boots planted wide. She holds a great forge hammer upright in both hands with its head on the floor, a long chisel stuck in her belt, the glow of the furnace on her face; a hard, steady stare.
formal: At the clan's gathering at the furnace hall: a long dark wool coat with a folded-down collar and big copper buttons over a clean shirt, a thick leather belt with a brass buckle, the three plaits freshly done and tied with a new brass ring set with a bead of ember-glass that glows dull orange, polished boots, the pouch of ash at her belt. She stands square, the hands clasped in front, a proud, solemn look.
art: A low-angle bust, the head slightly lowered, the big black eyes looking out of the dark at the viewer with a calm, appraising look, one thick-fingered hand lightly pressed to an unseen iron surface. Hard orange furnace light from below on one side. Foreground blur: drifting sparks and a chisel tip. She wears the leather apron with the row of chisels.

name: 米珂
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_一_犁的年月.md:952
who: Mika, a human bone-gatherer girl who works the edge of the dead lands at the southern end of the wall, fifteen but small and thin and looking only twelve or thirteen, a child and NOT a teenager: about 149 cm, long-limbed, wholly covered by her clothes. Short, ragged mint-green hair that she cuts with a knife herself, the tips always grey with ash; ash smeared on her face and neck that never washes clean. Large violet eyes that look first at what you are carrying that might be worth something. A patch of pale scar tissue on her right palm (on the viewer's left when they face us), from reaching into places she should not. Around her neck a string of copper rings that clink. A quick, wary, scavenging air.
palette: mint green and ash grey, violet, old army olive-brown, dull copper
casual: Her everyday clothes: an old army coat of unknown origin, far too big, the sleeves rolled three times and buttoned to the throat over a long-sleeved tunic and wide trousers tucked into old boots; a prying crowbar and a short knife at her belt, a wicker back-basket holding a roll of cloth, a coil of rope and a bag of ash. The string of copper rings jingles at her neck. She holds a copper ring up to look at it, a sharp, sideways look.
private: Back at her shelter at night: an oversized undyed wool shirt down to the knees under a patched blanket worn as a shawl, thick socks, the mint hair untied, the copper rings in her hand. She counts them one by one, a sleepy, careful look.
battle: Climbing into a fallen machine: the oversized army coat buttoned up, the sleeves rolled, a rope tied round her waist and a bag of ash at her belt. She holds the crowbar upright in both hands in front of her like a staff, the knife tucked into her belt, braced low; a wary, determined frown.
battle_pose: 3) the scavenging outfit: crouched low and alert, the feet planted, a wary frown, gripping a long iron crowbar in both hands in front of her; she does not fight.
formal: Asked to a gathering at the winding yard: the old army coat brushed free of ash with the sleeves let down and the collar left open, a clean tunic beneath, the hair combed flat with water, the string of copper rings worn outside the coat now and glinting with a faint warm light. She stands very straight with the hands behind her back, a stiff, suspicious little look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the large violet eyes looking sideways at the viewer to check what you are carrying, a closed mouth. Cold grey dead-land light from one side and a warm lantern glow from below. Foreground blur: drifting ash and a loop of copper rings. She wears the oversized army coat buttoned to the collar.

name: 马蒂亚斯
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_一_犁的年月.md:1008
who: Matthias, a human herald of a southern wall-city's half-emptied garrison, nineteen and looking eighteen or nineteen: about 178 cm, tall and thin with his shoulders not yet filled out, a grown young man and not a child. Short wheat-coloured hair with his ears sticking out red from the cold, a cold-flushed face with a peeling nose, full lips with a ring of hard callus all round the middle from the mouthpiece, blue eyes that keep drifting behind whoever he talks to in case someone is listening. A nervous, earnest, lip-licking air before he speaks.
build: Tall and thin, narrow-shouldered, with a young man's long limbs.
palette: wheat gold and cold-flush pink, patched leather brown, tarnished brass, sky blue
casual: His herald's clothes: an old wall-herald's leather jerkin over a wool shirt, the shoulder strap rubbed shiny, dark trousers and boots; on his back a long brass horn whose runed mouth-ring is still furred with verdigris, a small horn and a short spear at his belt. He licks his lips before speaking, a nervous, earnest look.
private: Sitting on the wall at dusk: a loose undyed wool shirt with the collar open, the jerkin off, the long horn lying beside him, an apple in one hand. He glances over his shoulder to see if anyone is listening, a shy, relaxed look.
battle: On the gate tower at the signal: the leather jerkin buckled tight, the shoulder strap on, the polished horn lifted to his lips in both hands with the bell pointing up and out, the short spear leaning at his side; his chest filled, a fierce, focused look.
formal: At the garrison's muster: a clean brown wool coat worn open at the neck over the leather jerkin, a strip of grey wall-herald's cloth on the shoulder, the horn's runed mouth-ring polished bright and humming faintly, hair combed flat. He stands very straight holding the horn at his side, a stiff, proud look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the blue eyes darting to one side behind the viewer and then back, the lips pressed together after licking them. Cold bright morning light from one side. Foreground blur: a polished brass horn bell and drifting breath-mist. He wears the leather jerkin with the strap rubbed shiny.

name: 苔拉·长辙
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_一_犁的年月.md:1159
who: Tira of the Longrut family, a halfling carter driving the lead cart on the salt road, thirty-seven: about 102 cm, short, sturdy and compact, with cheeks reddened by salt wind and a square chin. Red hair in one thick braid with a small brass bell tied at its end that rings at every step, lake-green eyes that squint before looking at anything as if weighing it, a thin pale scar through her left eyebrow (on the viewer's right when they face us) from a cart overturning at nineteen. Short, thick fingers with salt always under the nails. A shrewd, brisk, bell-ringing air. The old scar is a single thin pale line that cuts straight through her left eyebrow (on the viewer's right when they face us); there is NO mark on her forehead or anywhere else on her face.
build: 102 cm, small and sturdy, with strong thick wrists.
palette: salt-wind red and rust, lake green, worn leather brown, brass
casual: Her carter's clothes: a short leather coat with the cuffs rubbed bright by reins, a ring of small brass bells sewn round the hem (a bell-tail rule of the trade), a small steelyard scale hanging at the belt, a tin tube on her back holding a long scroll, trousers and thick-soled soft boots she never takes off on or off the cart. She holds the lead rein, a squinting, weighing look.
private: At camp by the salt-road fire: an old long-sleeved wool jumper over a plain skirt, thick socks, the braid hanging over one shoulder, the leather coat spread over her knees. She is polishing the little brass bell on her braid with a rag, a warm, tired look.
battle: Holding a wagon train together: the short leather coat buttoned up, leather bracers on the forearms, the bell-ringed hem swinging, the braid tucked into her collar. She holds a long cart whip coiled in one hand and the lead rein of two startled mules in the other, braced on the driver's bench; a sharp, level stare.
formal: At a trade-house signing: a clean dark-green wool coat with a wide folded collar and brass buttons over a white shirt, the braid freshly done with a new ribbon under the bell, the steelyard scale polished at her belt with rune marks along the beam that glow when the weight is true, the tin tube held under one arm. She stands tall for her size, a poised, businesslike look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the head tilted, the lake-green eyes squinting at the viewer as if weighing them, a small brisk closed-mouth smile. Hard white salt-flat light from one side. Foreground blur: a swinging brass bell and drifting grains of salt. She wears the short leather coat with the bells on the hem.

name: 尼科·盐蹄
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_一_犁的年月.md:1215
who: Nico Saltshoe, a dog-eared beastkin caravan guard-captain of the salt road, thirty-five: about 186 cm, tall with wide shoulders, long legs and a thick back. A pair of drooping white dog ears (he has NO human ears), a fluffy white tail, a layer of short salt-white fur down the back of his neck to his shoulder blades, short salt-white hair, warm yellow eyes that sniff the air before they look at you. An old knife scar from his left cheekbone to the jaw (on the viewer's right when they face us), taken at twenty-three shielding a cart. A silent, steady air in which his tail speaks before his mouth does.
build: Tall and broad-shouldered, long-legged, with a deep thick back.
palette: salt white and warm yellow, worn leather brown, tarnished copper, hemp-rope fawn
casual: His guard-captain's clothes: a worn leather armour with three Saltshoe family copper buttons on the breast, over a plain wool shirt, dark trousers and heavy boots, a slit in the back of the trousers for the tail; a barbed short spear in his right hand, its shaft bound with pack-cord, and a measuring staff at his belt cut with one notch for every day's road, flipped to a fresh side when full. A calm, watchful look.
private: At camp by the fire: a loose undyed linen shirt with the sleeves rolled and the collar open, soft trousers, the armour off beside the spear, the tail curled round his boots. He scratches the notches on the measuring staff with a thumbnail, a quiet, contented look.
battle: On caravan guard: the leather armour buckled over the three Saltshoe copper buttons and stitched with faint wall-wards, leather bracers, the barbed spear gripped low in both hands with a small rune plate on its head, ready to hook a rider off a mule, weight on the back foot, ears pinned flat, tail low and stiff; a hard, level stare.
formal: At a trade-house signing: a clean dark-brown wool coat of a plain wall-trade cut worn open at the neck over a white shirt, the three Saltshoe copper buttons sewn on the breast, a salt-white scarf, the tail opening at the back laced neatly, polished boots, the spear left at his side. A small brass road-charm swings from his belt. He stands very straight, a stiff, composed look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the warm yellow eyes looking at the viewer after a sniff of the air, one white ear lifted, the closed mouth showing nothing while a corner of the tail sways into the frame. Hard white salt-flat light from one side. Foreground blur: drifting salt grains and a rope-bound spear shaft. He wears the worn leather armour with the three copper buttons.
art_extra: Both of his ears are long, soft, drooping white dog ears hanging down beside his face, NOT upright or pointed; no ear stands up.

name: 哈诺
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_一_犁的年月.md:1271
who: Hano, a ten-year-old white-bone demon-kin boy rescued from a salt-road slave wagon, a small child and NOT a teenager: about 134 cm, thin and a little short for his age, wholly covered by his clothes. Near-human with the bones showing through: skin pale, and the knuckles, collarbones and brow ridge a gleaming bone white as if the bone pushes against the skin. Hair cropped very short and ash-grey, shaved with a knife in the camp. Eyes a grey so pale it is nearly white, open even at night. The little finger of his left hand is crooked (on the viewer's right when they face us), broken by a wagon door at eight and set back by himself in the dark, healed wrong. A silent, watchful, never-sleeping air that follows people with its eyes. He looks like a small ten-year-old child: a round soft child's face, big eyes, a small body, clearly not a teenager. The bone-white is clearly visible on the backs of his knuckles and on his brow ridge, a pale ivory shine under the skin. The crooked little finger of his left hand (on the viewer's right when they face us) is clearly drawn bent sideways and visible in every panel.
palette: bone white and ash grey, pale washed-out grey eyes, coarse hemp, a little rust red
casual: His everyday clothes: an ill-fitting coarse hemp shirt with the sleeves rolled three times and buttoned at the neck, rough trousers rolled at the shin, bare feet with a faint red ring of old chafing at each ankle. He stands very still with his arms at his sides, the crooked little finger visible, a quiet, watchful look.
private: Settled under a wagon at night: an oversized undyed wool shirt to the knees with a blanket round his shoulders, wool leg-wraps and cloth shoes, the grey hair rumpled. He keeps his eyes open on the dark, the hands wrapped in the blanket edge, a still, attentive look.
battle: Not a fighter; standing guard over the wagon in the dark: the hemp shirt buttoned up to the neck under an old wool jacket, cloth boots, a rope belt. He holds a small shuttered lantern in both hands in front of him and watches the road, his weight steady, a wary, unblinking stare.
battle_pose: 3) the night-watch outfit: very still and alert, the feet together and planted, a firm unblinking expression, holding a small shuttered lantern in both hands in front of him; he does not fight.
formal: Taken before the salt-road master: a clean coarse linen shirt buttoned to the neck under a patched but brushed brown jacket, rough trousers, cloth shoes, the hair wetted flat. He stands very straight with the hands clasped in front, the crooked finger showing, a solemn, watchful little face.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the nearly white grey eyes looking straight at the viewer, steady and open, the mouth closed. Cold pale blue night light from one side and a thin warm line of lantern light from the other. Foreground blur: drifting salt grains and the edge of a worn notebook. He wears the coarse hemp shirt buttoned at the neck.

name: 梅尔希奥·韦伯
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_一_犁的年月.md:1689
who: Melchior Weber, a human blood-inspector of the Cleansing Wall, fifty: about 178 cm, tall, lean and straight-backed. Close-cropped greying hair, a long clean-shaven face, pale hazel eyes, long dry clean fingers that do not shake when they hold a needle. His grey robe has been washed pale, and a white stone knocked from the long wall is pinned at the collar, rubbed smooth like a tooth. He speaks in a low, soft voice and reads out numbers clearly. A courteous, precise, certain air that believes it is saving people.
build: Tall, lean and straight-backed, with long hands.
face: FACE, as in the references: a long, lean, clean-shaven face of a man of fifty, fine lines at the corners of the eyes and the mouth, pale hazel eyes calm and slightly lowered, thin straight brows, a straight nose, a thin firm mouth; a faint stern line between the brows; skin pale and clean. Skin shadows are a soft cool pink.
palette: washed grey and chalk white, pale hazel, dull silver, ledger black
casual: His inspector's clothes: a long grey robe washed pale that closes down the front with buttons, fitted sleeves, a white stone pinned at the collar like a tooth, a plain dark belt with a ledger book and a slim leather case of silver needles hanging from it, polished black shoes. He holds the ledger against his chest, a calm, courteous look.
private: Evening in the stone house of the order: the robe off, a long-sleeved undyed wool shirt buttoned to the neck and dark trousers, soft indoor shoes. He sits writing a line in the ledger by a candle, the white stone set beside it. A tired, quiet look.
battle: Not a fighter; at his work in the courtyard: the grey robe buttoned to the throat, sleeves rolled back from the wrists. In the full light of the day he holds a white stone up to the sun in his left hand and a thin silver needle in his right, bent to look at it; a patient, precise look.
battle_pose: 3) the inspection outfit: upright and precise, the feet together, a calm expression, holding a white stone up to the daylight in one hand and a thin silver needle in the other; he does not fight.
formal: Leading the grey-robed inspectors into a city: a freshly pressed grey robe of the Cleansing Wall, a plain turned-down collar open at the throat, the white stone pinned at the collar giving off a faint cold light, a black belt with a silver clasp, a case of silver needles, the ledger under one arm. He stands very straight at the head of the line, a grave, composed look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the head tilted slightly down, the pale hazel eyes looking calmly at the viewer, the mouth closed and level. Hard clear daylight from one side. Foreground blur: a white stone held up and a silver needle tip. He wears the pale grey robe with the white stone at the collar.

name: 辛美尔
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_一_犁的年月.md:1706
who: Himmel, a human hero who looks twenty-eight and has looked it since he became a legend, about 172 cm, short for a hero and slight, a slim light frame with neat narrow shoulders gone a little slow and tired in these last years. Blue hair with one lock hanging over the forehead that he brushes aside with a finger before he speaks, a delicate, refined, fine-boned face exactly like the reference picture: a slim jaw, a small fine nose, large clear pale-blue eyes, fine light brows and a gentle mouth, pretty rather than rugged, a small beauty mark under the outer corner of his left eye (on the viewer's right when they face us), pale blue eyes whose corners curve first when he smiles. A warm, joking, easy air, and underneath it a tireless carefulness; he counts the people in a room before he sits.
build: Short and slight: about 172 cm, about 6.8 heads tall, a slim, light, boyish frame with neat narrow shoulders, NOT broad, NOT heavy, NOT tall; a little slowed and tired.
palette: sky blue and flax linen, steel grey, a thin white glow, faded paint
casual: His travelling clothes: a long flax-coloured linen cloak trailing to the ankles, its hem fraying longer every year, over a fitted blue tunic belted at the waist with dark trousers and worn boots; at his belt a plain single-handed sword copied from a famous one, its lacquer all worn off and its edge ground by a dwarf. The left sleeve is buttoned to the wrist, a faint white glow showing under the cuff. He smiles with the corners of the eyes, a warm, easy look.
private: Sitting on a wall at night: the cloak off and folded under him, a loose pale linen shirt with the sleeves rolled on the right arm and the left sleeve buttoned shut, the sword laid across his knees. He pulls the cloak over his left arm so the glow does not wake anyone. A tired, gentle look.
battle: Ready for a hard night on the wall: the flax cloak thrown back, a plain brigandine over the blue tunic, leather bracers, the left sleeve buttoned tight over the faintly glowing arm. He grips the worn plain sword upright in his right hand before him, the blade lit by a pale blue glow, and counts heads with a glance over his shoulder; a calm, determined stance.
formal: Asked to an audience in a wall-city: a long clean flax-coloured cloak, the blue tunic pressed and buttoned to the collar, the sword at his side in a polished scabbard, the blue hair tidied with the one lock left falling. He stands in a deliberately heroic pose with one hand on the sword hilt and a sheepish half-smile, a warm look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the pale blue eyes looking at the viewer with a warm, crinkling look, a brush of the finger over the lock of hair on his forehead. Cool blue night light from one side with a faint white glow rising from his left sleeve. Foreground blur: a worn sword hilt and drifting night-wall dust. He wears the long flax cloak over the blue tunic.

name: 海塔
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_一_犁的年月.md:1722
who: Heiter, a human priest of the White Candle, a drinker and a healer, who looks thirty-five and has looked it since he became a legend: about 183 cm, tall and thin with a slight stoop from many hours sitting at bedsides. Short green hair combed straight back, a pair of square-framed glasses, brown eyes half-drooping behind them, a faintly red nose. His white robe has narrow gold trim, the hem stiffened by candle wax, and the front is stained with wine marks that never come out. A joking, loose-tongued air and a mind clearer than anyone's.
build: Tall and thin, a little stooped, with long hands.
palette: candle white and narrow gold, soft green, wine red, brown
casual: His priest's clothes: a white robe with narrow gold trim that closes down the front with buttons, fitted sleeves, the hem stiff with candle wax and the front stained with wine, a worn leather wine flask at his belt with a stub of never-lit white candle pushed into its mouth, a needle and thread for stitching wounds tucked in a sleeve. He raises the flask a little, a loose, friendly smile.
private: Resting at an inn: a loose undyed linen shirt with the collar open and the sleeves rolled, soft trousers, the robe over the back of a chair, the glasses pushed up on his forehead. He sits with a tankard in his hand and eyes half-closed, a sleepy, content look.
battle: Healing on the line: the white robe belted tight, the sleeves pushed up, the glasses on, his right palm lifted and glowing with a soft white light, the other hand on the wine flask at his belt; he kneels on one knee and does not fight.
battle_pose: 3) the healing outfit: kneeling on one knee, steady and unhurried, his right palm lifted and glowing with a soft white light, the other hand resting on the wine flask at his belt; he does not fight.
formal: Leading a rite at the White Candle shrine: a fresh white robe with narrow gold trim and a soft folded collar open at the neck, a gold-stitched stole over the shoulders, the hem clean, a white candle held lit in both hands whose flame stays steady in any draught, the wine flask left at home, the green hair neat. He stands upright, a solemn, genuine look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the head tilted, the half-drooping brown eyes looking at the viewer through square glasses with a lazy, knowing smile, a stub of unlit white candle held up near his chin. Warm candle light from one side. Foreground blur: dripping candle wax and the neck of a leather flask. He wears the white robe with the gold trim.

name: 艾冯
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_一_犁的年月.md:1738
who: Eisen, a dwarf axeman of the Deepwell clan, one hundred and thirty and looking about sixty, a legend whose beard and hair turned white in one night: about 140 cm, short, enormously broad, his shoulders wider across than a doorway. He never takes off his old iron helmet with two curved horns and a nose guard pulled down to the brows, under which grow long bushy white brows over small deep-set eyes. White hair and a white beard braided into two plaits bound with iron rings, hanging to the waist. The knuckles of both hands are flat. His joints are stiff in these years and he sits a while each morning before he stands. A short-spoken, immovable, honest air.
build: Short and enormously broad: a barrel chest, a thick neck and heavy forearms.
palette: old iron grey and bone-white beard, washed-out red, dull brass, dark soot
casual: His everyday gear: the old horned iron helmet, an old Deepwell chain shirt with a pair of iron pauldrons, a red cloak washed down to a faint red hanging from his shoulders, thick belt, iron-capped boots; a single-edged Deepwell axe with its back hammered flat on one side and a deep pit dented in its face that he will not let anyone beat out, and a small brass lamp lit at his belt even in broad daylight. He stands square, a stern, appraising look.
private: Sitting at the door of his house: the helmet still on, but the chain shirt and pauldrons off, a heavy undyed wool tunic with the sleeves rolled, the old red cloak across his knees, the little lamp burning beside him. He holds a clay mug in a big flat-knuckled hand, a quiet, tired look.
battle: Holding the ground: the iron helmet, the chain shirt and pauldrons buckled tight, the faded red cloak thrown over one shoulder. He grips the axe in both hands across his body with the pitted face outward, the feet planted wide, the white beard braids hanging over the mail; an immovable, level stare.
formal: At the Deepwell hearth-hall: a long dark-grey wool coat with iron buttons over the mail, the horned helmet polished but still on, the red cloak brushed, the beard braids freshly bound with new iron rings, the axe left leaning at his side. He stands very straight with the hands at his sides, a grave look.
art: A low-angle broad bust, the head slightly lowered under the horned helmet, the small deep-set eyes looking from under the white brows at the viewer, a stern but honest look, one flat-knuckled hand holding up a small burning brass lamp. Warm firelight from below on one side. Foreground blur: drifting sparks and the pitted face of an axe. He wears the horned helmet and the faded red cloak.

name: 巴尔缇娜·格雷恩
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_一_犁的年月.md:1754
who: Baltina Grain, a long-lived demon-kin girl raised by the Grey Rain city, who looks sixteen: small and slim, about 150 cm, standing up to an ordinary man's shoulder, wholly covered by her clothes. Long ash-grey hair down to the waist in one plain braid, cold pale skin, slightly pointed ears, a small red mark at the corner of her forehead like a chip of red jade. Gold eyes that glow faintly in the dark. At her belt a leather-bound notebook that she fills and replaces. A serious, orderly, slow-to-laugh air; she says what she means to do and then what the other side must agree to. A small round red mark like a chip of red jade sits at the left corner of her forehead where the hairline meets it, clearly visible and always shown in every panel, never hidden by her fringe; her ears are only slightly pointed, short and small.
palette: ash grey and cold silver, gold, a small ember-red mark, worn cloak grey
casual: Her travelling clothes: a grey cloak with the cuffs worn fuzzy, closed at the throat with a plain clasp, over a plain long-sleeved wool dress to the shins, dark leggings and sturdy ankle boots; at her belt a leather-bound notebook and a small ink pen on a cord. The long braid hangs over one shoulder. She holds the notebook closed against her chest, a serious, attentive look.
private: In the gatehouse by the fire: a soft long-sleeved grey wool dress with a high neck, thick stockings and soft shoes, the braid undone and brushed loose, the cloak hung on a peg. She spreads thick blackberry jam on a slice of bread, a pleased, sleepy look.
battle: Not a fighter; on the road at dusk with something to settle: the grey cloak fastened at the throat, the hood back, leather bracers over the sleeves, the notebook open in her left hand. Her right palm is held upward and a small steady smokeless lamp flame burns in it; she keeps her chin level, a calm, serious look.
battle_pose: 3) the road-at-dusk outfit: upright and composed, the feet together and planted, a firm serious expression, the notebook open in one hand and a small steady smokeless flame held on the other palm; she does not fight.
formal: Speaking for the city at a table: a clean long grey wool coat with a wide folded collar, long sleeves, a plain clasp at the chest, the cloak brushed and pinned neatly, the braid tied with a plain dark ribbon, the notebook closed in one hand while a small smokeless lamp flame floats above the other palm. She stands very straight, a grave, polite look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the gold eyes open and looking straight at the viewer with a serious, steady look, the mouth closed. Cold blue dusk light from one side and a warm lamp glow from below. Foreground blur: drifting rain drops and the edge of a leather notebook. She wears the grey cloak with the worn cuffs.
